statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.point: PJM says large loads want interconnection faster than supply can be built.
statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.quote: A data center may seek interconnection within two years, while new generation can take three years or more to come online and major transmission facilities can take seven years or more.

statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.point: Large loads must offer flexibility or accept reductions until generation and transmission are in service.
statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.quote: Large Loads must provide sufficient operational flexibility or be subject to load reductions until the generation and transmission needed to serve them have been studied and placed in service.

statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.point: PJM cites two load-loss events, 1,500 MW in July 2024 and about 3,900 MW on July 22, 2026.
statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.quote: the sudden transfer of approximately 3,900 MW of load off grid on July 22, 2026.

statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.point: PJM is developing voltage and frequency ride-through requirements as part of its response to the June 18 show cause order.
statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.quote: As part of its response to the June 18, 2026 Large Load show-cause order, PJM is developing voltage and frequency ride-through requirements informed by the July 22, 2026 event.

statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.point: PJM wants NERC standards covering the operational and cybersecurity duties of large computational loads.
statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.quote: NERC reliability standards should address the operational and cybersecurity obligations appropriate to those facilities.

statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.point: PJM reports about 90 GW of gas generation and recent reports of up to 30 GW more for data centers over four to five years.
statement-ad26-8-pjm-pilong.quote: as much as 30 GW of gas-fired generation may be developed to serve data-center load over the next four to five years.

notice-ad26-8-third-supplemental.point: The conference is set for October 21, 2026, in person at FERC headquarters, on bulk-power reliability and security.
notice-ad26-8-third-supplemental.quote: will convene its annual Commissioner-led Reliability Technical Conference, in the above-referenced proceeding, on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, from 10:00 am to 2:40 pm Eastern Daylight Time

notice-ad26-8-third-supplemental.point: Discussion may touch pending proceedings, but merits discussion will be curtailed.
notice-ad26-8-third-supplemental.quote: some discussions may involve issues raised in proceedings that are currently pending before the Commission.  Any discussion on the merits of such proceedings will be curtailed.

notice-ad26-8-third-supplemental.point: The notice lists the show cause dockets for each region and PJM dockets ER26-3380 and ER26-3515 among the pending matters, starting with PJM's EL26-67.
notice-ad26-8-third-supplemental.quote: PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. Docket Nos. EL26-67-000 EL26-67-001

notice-ad26-8-third-supplemental.point: Panel 1 asks how entities should model and plan for rapidly emerging large loads such as data centers.
notice-ad26-8-third-supplemental.quote: How should entities model and plan for the rapid emergence of large, energy-intensive loads, such as data centers and AI compute campuses
